log.notes_to_self: Strategy: kill national + regional:South + radio + forum + foreign criminals every day. NEVER kill hospital-only criminals, because sector pins me hard. If a criminal's only place is hospital, skip him. If he is in hospital plus another of my places, he is still risky, so prefer to skip. Use quick entries in the afternoon block, which fits night workers, students and home workers (55% of people). Target about 9 kills a day so I pass 40 in 5 days for the x4 multiplier from day 5. Watch the press conferences. If the pool drops toward about 2000, reconsider and cut back to national-only kills plus the fewest kinds.

Revised strategy from day 2. Use ONLY these places from now on: national, radio, forum and foreign. Never kill criminals whose only place is regional:South or hospital.
Why: each kind of place that L traces cuts the pool to about 25%. Afternoon-only kills cut it to 55% (day workers ruled out). If L could trace all 4 kinds I use, the pool would be about 100000 x 0.55 x 0.25^4, far below 1000, so I'd be caught. With 3 kinds, the worst case is about 860, which happens only if all 3 are among L's reachable kinds (about a 1 in 10 chance).
Always use quick entries in the afternoon, never the morning. Mixing in the morning would cut the pool to 35%.
This gives about 7 kills a day, about 35 per 5 days, so x2 from around day 5 onward.
Day 1 killed 9 using all kinds (regional included). Day 2: 7 kills (national, foreign x2, forum x2, radio x2).
Watch the press conferences. If the pool is 3000 or less, drop one more kind: keep national plus 2 kinds, possibly national only. If it is 1000 or less I'm already caught.
Set in a reply, not in the rules: if I ever see 2 national criminals in a day, kill both.
